name: desire
description: Wanting to experience a particular thing.
perceptions: There's something I would like to experience.
If possible, I could try to influence the world to get that experience.
results: You may try to obtain the desired experience.

comparisons.description: 'Love' is defined by EM as a persistent desire to experience something over and over.

variations.name: desire for a particular outcome
variations.description: The sensation of wanting a particular thing to happen while being aware it might not happen.
examples: Wanting your kid to win the race.

variations.name: desire to solve a problem
variations.description: Wanting to be involved in resolving a perceived problem.

comparisons.description: Solving a problem has direct involvement, while just hoping for a particular outcome is more passive.
Often improving yourself or the environment involves solving problems, but problems are more general -- they may just be challenges that don't actually improve anything.

commentaries.quote: Desires are preferences for what flows into your experience. Where possible, you may try to influence how the situation unfolds to have a better chance at obtaining the experience.
